Bug Description: Division by zero error on fresh installation when Total Employees count is 0, crashing the entire dashboard view.
Expected Logic: Attendance percentage formula must guard against zero denominator: totalEmployees > 0 ? round((presentCount / totalEmployees) * 100) : 0, displaying 0% gracefully.

Bug Description: Finance cards throw SQL missing table exceptions when optional tables (contracts, invoices, payments, deals) are not yet migrated.
Expected Logic: Controller must use safeTableSum() with Schema::hasTable() and Schema::hasColumn() checks returning 0.0 float fallback instead of unhandled SQL errors.

Bug Description: Delivery Risk evaluation returns NaN or High Load error when Total Projects count is 0.
Expected Logic: Formula must clamp divisor using max($dashboardTotalProject, 1): score > 8 shows High Load (red), > 3 shows Watch Queue (amber), else Healthy (green).

Bug Description: Sparkline CSS bar height percentages calculate over 100% or under 0% on outlier data, overflowing the card boundaries.
Expected Logic: All 6 sparkline data values must be clamped within max(10, min(100, $value))% to maintain responsive card visual geometry.

Bug Description: Recent activities panel throws fatal error if project_activity table is missing, or displays timestamps in UTC instead of IST.
Expected Logic: Verify table presence with Schema::hasTable("project_activity") and format timestamps with configured application timezone: Carbon::parse($activity->created_at)->timezone(config("app.timezone")).

Bug Description: Clicking "Mark All as Read" fails with CSRF mismatch or leaves unread counter badge unchanged in the sidebar.
Expected Logic: POST request to notifications.readAll must validate CSRF token, update all records with read_at = now(), and reset unread badge count to 0 in DOM.

Bug Description: Filtering notifications by category (e.g. Tasks, Leaves, Tickets) returns notifications belonging to other tenant companies.
Expected Logic: Query must enforce tenant scoping where user_id === auth()->id() and company_id === auth()->user()->company_id across all category tabs.

Bug Description: Clicking a notification item for a deleted task or project throws 404 Not Found error without user-friendly alert.
Expected Logic: notifications.open action must verify if the target model exists; if soft-deleted or removed, display info banner "The referenced item no longer exists."

Bug Description: Uploading executable or malicious file formats (.exe, .sh, .bat) is allowed due to missing file MIME type validation.
Expected Logic: Backend validation must strictly enforce allowed extensions: mimes:pdf,doc,docx,xls,xlsx,jpg,png,zip with max file size limit (e.g. 10MB).

Bug Description: Users can download confidential documents belonging to other users or departments by manipulating document ID in the download URL.
Expected Logic: Download controller must authorize document ownership (user_id === auth()->id()) or verify company Admin/HR privileges before streaming file response.

Bug Description: Deleting a document removes the database record but leaves orphaned physical files consuming storage on the server.
Expected Logic: Storage::delete() must be invoked on the physical disk path inside a DB transaction before deleting the model record from the database.

Bug Description: Filtering by "In Progress" or "Overdue" status displays projects assigned to other companies or archived projects.
Expected Logic: Filter query must enforce whereNull("deleted_at") and where("company_id", auth()->user()->company_id) alongside user project allocation check.

Bug Description: Project completion percentage calculates as > 100% or produces NaN when a project has 0 total tasks.
Expected Logic: If total project tasks is 0, progress should display 0%; otherwise calculate (completedTasks / totalTasks) * 100 capped at 100%.

Bug Description: Milestone status toggle does not update linked tasks or project completion status in real time.
Expected Logic: Updating milestone to "Complete" should recalculate project overall progress and trigger system notification to assigned project managers.

Bug Description: Hierarchy tree crashes or goes into infinite loop if there is a circular reporting relationship between managers.
Expected Logic: Tree generator must detect circular references, validate parent-child loops, and render hierarchical nodes with smooth pan/zoom controls.

Bug Description: Updating an employee directory profile via PATCH route allows updating records belonging to other companies.
Expected Logic: Verify employee record belongs to auth()->user()->company_id; check user authorization before saving profile changes.

Bug Description: RSVP submission fails silently or allows submitting multiple conflicting attendance statuses for the same user.
Expected Logic: RSVP action must use updateOrCreate([user_id, event_id], [status]) validating in:accepted,declined,maybe with real-time attendee counter update.

Bug Description: Bulk photo upload crashes with memory overflow error when multiple high-resolution photos are uploaded simultaneously.
Expected Logic: Photos must be resized/optimized upon upload, stored with unique names, and batched within post_max_size and upload_max_filesize limits.

Bug Description: Canceling an event does not notify RSVP-confirmed attendees or leave a cancellation audit log.
Expected Logic: Canceling an event must mark status = "cancelled", send email/system notification to all confirmed attendees, and log action in UserActivity.

Bug Description: Community messages feed shows messages from other company workspaces in multi-tenant environment.
Expected Logic: CommunityMessage queries must always filter by company_id = auth()->user()->company_id and order by created_at ASC/DESC.

Bug Description: Non-admin users are able to pin or unpin messages, disrupting announcement order.
Expected Logic: Only users with admin or manager role should be authorized to invoke community.pin route; standard users receive 403 Forbidden.

Bug Description: Users can edit or delete messages posted by other team members.
Expected Logic: Message update/destroy routes must verify auth()->id() === $message->user_id or allow only superadmin/company admin override.

Bug Description: Auto-generated employee ID increments incorrectly or duplicates existing ID during concurrent registrations.
Expected Logic: nextId generator must lock employee table or calculate max(id) + 1 formatted with configured prefix (e.g. EMP-001) preventing collisions.

Bug Description: Changing an employee status to "Inactive" or "Terminated" does not revoke their active web sessions immediately.
Expected Logic: Deactivating an employee must update status in employee_details, invalidate active session tokens in sessions table, and block subsequent logins.

Bug Description: Bulk delete action does not handle foreign key constraints on attendance, tasks, or payroll records, causing 500 error.
Expected Logic: Bulk delete must check for related payroll and attendance records; soft-delete users where foreign keys exist or prompt confirmation.

Bug Description: Candidate application resume download link breaks when resume file name contains spaces or special characters.
Expected Logic: File storage must sanitize file names on upload; download route must stream file with proper Content-Disposition and Content-Type headers.

Bug Description: Updating candidate stage to "Hired" does not pre-fill employee onboarding form or notify HR manager.
Expected Logic: Marking candidate as "Hired" should offer one-click option to convert candidate profile into new employee record pre-populating name, email, and mobile.

Bug Description: Auto-calculate action crashes or generates score > 100% when employee has completed bonus tasks.
Expected Logic: Appraisal auto-calculation formula must weigh KPI metrics, completed tasks, and attendance scores, clamping final percentage between 0% and 100%.

Bug Description: Appraisal form allows submission without manager ratings or evaluation comments, creating blank records.
Expected Logic: Validate manager_score required|numeric|between:1,5 and review_comments required|string|min:10 before saving appraisal.

Bug Description: Creating a designation with an existing designation code is permitted, violating unique code constraints.
Expected Logic: DesignationController must validate code as unique for the tenant company (unique:designations,code,NULL,id,company_id) before saving.

Bug Description: Deleting a designation that is currently assigned to active employees leaves employees with orphan designation_id.
Expected Logic: System must check if designation has linked active employees; block deletion and prompt user to reassign employees first.

Bug Description: Selecting a parent department in employee form does not dynamically populate the matching sub-departments dropdown.
Expected Logic: AJAX endpoint /get-subdepartments/{parentId} must return active sub-departments scoped to the selected parent department and tenant company.

Bug Description: Bulk destroy action deletes parent departments while leaving child sub-departments orphaned in database.
Expected Logic: Cascading delete or confirmation dialog must require reassigning or deleting sub-departments prior to deleting parent department.

Bug Description: Attendance filter by date range displays duplicate rows when employee has multiple timer logs in a single shift.
Expected Logic: Query must group by user_id and date or distinct on attendance.id to ensure one attendance summary row per employee per day.

Bug Description: Admin marking manual attendance allows clock_out time earlier than clock_in time, resulting in negative worked hours.
Expected Logic: Validate clock_out as after:clock_in and compute worked hours accordingly; display validation error if clock_out is before clock_in.

Bug Description: Exporting attendance report for large team (> 200 employees) triggers script execution timeout (Max execution time exceeded).
Expected Logic: Export query must be chunked with cursor pagination, set memory limit appropriately, and stream generated Excel/PDF download cleanly.

Bug Description: Map view fails to render employee pins or throws Google Maps API Key invalid error.
Expected Logic: Verify Google Maps API key in App Settings; render OpenStreetMap / Leaflet or Google Map markers with employee selfie, name, and address popup.

Bug Description: Employee can apply for leaves exceeding their remaining allotted leave balance without warning.
Expected Logic: Controller must check employee used leaves against company leave quota settings for that leave type, alerting if quota is exceeded.

Bug Description: Approving a leave request does not notify the employee or update the team dashboard on-leave list.
Expected Logic: When Admin/Manager approves leave, status is set to "approved", employee receives instant notification/email, and dashboard displays them as on leave.

Bug Description: Adding a holiday on an existing weekend or duplicate date creates redundant calendar events.
Expected Logic: Validate holiday date unique for company_id and notify admin if the holiday falls on a regular non-working day (e.g. Sunday).

Bug Description: Employee award wall shows awards granted in other companies or awards with award_date in the future.
Expected Logic: Scope awards by company_id, filter award_date <= now(), and show employee avatar, award title, badge icon, and description.

Bug Description: Exporting letterhead to PDF causes logo distortion or overlapping header text in DomPDF.
Expected Logic: PDF layout template must specify explicit CSS width and height constraints on company logo and use clean table-based header formatting.

Bug Description: Marking a letterhead as default does not unmark the previously selected default letterhead, resulting in multiple defaults.
Expected Logic: Setting a letterhead as default must execute update(["is_default" => false]) for all other company letterheads in a transaction.

Bug Description: Task report date filter does not filter by task completion date, showing irrelevant tasks from prior periods.
Expected Logic: Allow filtering by start_date, due_date, or completed_at date ranges; export filtered task metrics cleanly to CSV/Excel.

Bug Description: Total logged hours calculation shows raw decimal fractions (e.g. 7.666666 hrs) instead of hours and minutes (7h 40m).
Expected Logic: Format logged time cleanly into HH:MM or round decimal hours to 2 decimal places with employee and project breakdown.

Bug Description: Finance report calculation includes voided or draft invoices, skewing the net profit figures.
Expected Logic: Calculate revenue solely from "paid" invoices/payments and subtract approved expenses, cleanly excluding cancelled or draft records.

Bug Description: Monthly attendance report counts holidays and approved leaves as unexcused absences.
Expected Logic: Report algorithm must cross-reference holidays table and approved leaves table before categorizing employee as absent.

Bug Description: Non-admin users can edit collaborating company details or delete external company partnerships.
Expected Logic: Strictly protect collaborating company CRUD routes with admin/manager role middleware; restrict standard employees to view-only.

Bug Description: Deleting a client with active ongoing projects does not warn user and leaves projects with broken client_id.
Expected Logic: Verify if client has linked active projects; display warning prompt and require reassigning or completing projects prior to deletion.

Bug Description: Enabling client login generates temporary password without sending welcome invitation email to client.
Expected Logic: If send_credentials checkbox is checked, trigger ClientLoginCredentialNotification email containing portal URL and initial password.

Bug Description: Project form allows selecting employees who have been deactivated or belong to a different company.
Expected Logic: Assignee dropdown must query users where company_id = auth()->user()->company_id and employee_details.status = "Active".

Bug Description: Saving project budget with comma formatting (e.g. "50,000") causes database error due to non-numeric string.
Expected Logic: Controller must sanitize input by stripping commas and non-numeric characters before validating as numeric|min:0.

Bug Description: Discussion comments allow script injection (XSS) in discussion thread body.
Expected Logic: Sanitize discussion reply content using Purifier or escape HTML in Blade template ({{ $comment->body }}) to prevent XSS attacks.

Bug Description: Dragging task card between Kanban columns fails to update task status in database on slow network connection.
Expected Logic: AJAX status update must include retry logic and rollback UI card position to original column with error toast if request fails.

Bug Description: Task assigned_to stores raw comma-separated string without syncing task_user pivot table, breaking relationship queries.
Expected Logic: Controller must sync assignees in task_user relationship table ($task->assignees()->sync($userIds)) and trigger TaskAssignedNotification.

Bug Description: Employee can self-approve their own submitted tasks without manager sign-off.
Expected Logic: Only users with manager or admin role for the project should see and execute "Approve Task" action; employee view is read-only.

Bug Description: Employee able to log overlapping time entries for the same date and time range across different tasks.
Expected Logic: Controller must validate that start_time and end_time do not overlap with existing confirmed logs for the same user.

Bug Description: Timelog bulk delete route deletes logs from other companies if request payload sends arbitrary IDs.
Expected Logic: Bulk delete must verify all submitted timelog IDs belong to auth()->user()->company_id before executing deletion.

Bug Description: Client signing contract with drawn signature canvas uploads corrupt base64 string, failing PDF signature embed.
Expected Logic: Validate canvas signature PNG data URI, store cleanly on disk, and render client signature image on final exported contract PDF.

Bug Description: Contract template placeholders (e.g. {CLIENT_NAME}, {START_DATE}) do not get replaced with actual client/contract values.
Expected Logic: Template parser must perform regex replacement on all defined placeholders before rendering final contract body.

Bug Description: Monthly payroll processing calculates gross salary without deducting unpaid leaves or half-days.
Expected Logic: Payroll engine must cross-examine attendance status (day_off, half_day, unpaid_leaves) and deduct pro-rated amounts according to policy rules.

Bug Description: Tax deduction rule applies flat percentage on total salary without subtracting standard exemption slabs.
Expected Logic: Tax rule calculation must apply progressive income tax slabs (e.g. New Tax Regime slabs) or use company defined tax rules.

Bug Description: Generating payslip PDF for an employee with zero deductions renders broken table layout or NaN total.
Expected Logic: Payslip template must handle empty deduction or bonus arrays cleanly, displaying ₹0.00 and computing Net Pay = Gross - Deductions.

Bug Description: Changes to payroll salary rules are not tracked in audit logs, preventing tracking of salary modifications.
Expected Logic: Any update to employee salary structure, bonus rules, or deductions must insert an entry into payroll_audit_logs with old/new values.

Bug Description: Importing lead contacts from CSV with duplicate email addresses overwrites existing leads without notification.
Expected Logic: Import logic must check for duplicate emails; allow user to choose between "Skip Duplicates" or "Update Existing Records".

Bug Description: Moving a deal to "Won" does not provide option to convert lead into active client or create project automatically.
Expected Logic: When deal stage transitions to "Won", display modal offering one-click conversion to Client record and Project creation with prefilled budget.

Bug Description: Product price allows negative values or non-numeric characters, corrupting order totals.
Expected Logic: Validate price as required|numeric|min:0 and SKU as unique for the company (unique:products,sku,NULL,id,company_id).

Bug Description: Order tax percentage calculation does not update total order amount dynamically on line item addition.
Expected Logic: Adding product line items must recalculate subtotal, apply line tax or global tax percentage, and update grand total accurately.

Bug Description: Assigning ticket to an agent does not update agent workload counter or dispatch notification to assigned agent.
Expected Logic: Agent assignment must update agent_id on ticket, send notification/email to the assigned agent, and increment agent active ticket queue.

Bug Description: Replying to a closed ticket keeps ticket in closed state instead of reopening or prompting status change.
Expected Logic: Client reply on a closed ticket should automatically switch ticket status to "reopened" and alert assigned support agent.

Bug Description: Tenant admin submitting platform complaint cannot view replies sent by Superadmin.
Expected Logic: Thread view must show chronological conversation messages between Tenant Admin and Superadmin with attachment support and unread indicators.

Bug Description: Uploading company logo with large resolution breaks top navbar and invoice header layouts.
Expected Logic: Logo upload must validate image dimensions (or auto-resize to standard 250x80px max) and maintain aspect-ratio across all header components.

Bug Description: Updating office start time (e.g. 09:30 AM) does not update late threshold calculation for future attendance records.
Expected Logic: Saving work schedule settings must update attendance_settings table and take effect for all subsequent attendance clock-in evaluations.

Bug Description: Unchecking a module permission for "Manager" role does not revoke access to corresponding direct URL routes.
Expected Logic: Route middleware module.access must inspect role_permissions table and abort with 403 Forbidden if permission is unchecked.

Bug Description: Disabling a module (e.g. Payroll or Tickets) keeps the menu item visible in the sidebar for users.
Expected Logic: Sidebar menu items must be wrapped with @if($canSeeModule("module-slug")); toggling module to inactive must hide it immediately.

Bug Description: Changing admin password allows submitting current password as new password without minimum complexity requirements.
Expected Logic: Enforce password rules: min:8 characters, at least one uppercase, one number, and one symbol; reject if identical to old password.
